captureContract.liveCaptureGate: test/plan_final/oracle/launch-reference-cleanly.test.ts gates the live launch behind a check for every REFERENCE_SANDBOX_POLICY.requiredFiles entry being present on disk; environments without the reference bundle run only the static contract test.

crossPlanInventoryUpdate.rationale: Adding tools/reference/launchReferenceCleanly.ts triggers the plan_vanilla_parity tools/reference capture-surface inventory (file count + hardcoded 3 → 4) the same way 02-001 added createReferenceSandbox.ts. The inventory JSON gains a new capture_modules row pinning the new module's size_bytes, line_count, sha256, exported surface, importer counts, and companion test path; the inventory test's hardcoded tools_reference_file_count and capture_modules.length assertions both move from 3 to 4. No proprietary id Software bytes were embedded — only on-disk metadata.
